warnings: Marks are kept exactly as printed (ป1/ป2 for doors, น1/น2/น3 for windows, §0.3). Houses 01-05 and 17 relabeled to D1/W1 only because their sheets restarted bare numbers in each group and would have collided; here the printed prefixes ป/น already keep doors and windows apart, so no relabel was needed.

View 3 (แบบขยายราวระเบียง — ราวไม้ 2"x4", ซี่ไม้เนื้อแข็ง □1 1/2"x1 1/2" @0.10 ม., สูง 0.80) is a railing detail, not a door/window, and sits outside op04's schedule scope — inventoried in views[] and deliberately not extracted.
Opening heights are measured from 'ระดับพื้น' of whichever floor the opening is on; floor-plan counts (A-04) are not tallied here.
